note: Recreation area owned by the Tehachapi-Cummings County Water District and run by the Tehachapi Valley Recreation & Park District on Brite Valley Reservoir NW of Tehachapi. The hookup loops sit on open ground above the lake's SE shore; the dry spaces lie nearer the water. The lake is a drinking-water supply: no swimming or body contact, electric boat motors only. Dock and fish-cleaning stations. --Claude
summary: Operator page + brochure read: $35 E/W / $45 FHU (30 A) / $30 dry, $3.50 fee, $5 extra car; 48 spaces (1-18 hookups), phone booking via camp host, 21-night max, year-round, showers + dump. Lakeview kept. Re-pin ~205 m to the hookup loops.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakeview' kept. Hookup spaces 1-18 sit ~150-200 m from the SE shore across open scrub (3DEP: steady 10-13 m fall from 35.1020,-118.5430 and 35.1022,-118.5405 to the water, nothing between). The brochure's dry spaces (36-48, e.g. 43-48 on the NE arm ~35.1060,-118.5385) sit within ~20-40 m of the shore, but the operator prices 19-48 as 'Tent Camping', so no RV-bookable site earns a lakefront value.

PIN: stored 35.1039,-118.5392 is on an unmarked serpentine dirt track NE of the campground (not a campsite); suggest 35.1024,-118.5405 between the hookup loops by the payment entrance (~205 m; 3DEP 1341 m vs stored 1336 m).
PHONE: 661-221-2832 confirmed (camp host). WEBSITE: https://www.tvrpd.org/brite-lake confirmed.
FIT: no posted length limit; nothing singles out small rigs. Max length unknown.
Open; golden mussels found in the district's water system (boat clean-drain-dry rules only). Brochure (2022) gives camp-host hours as 8-5; the live page says 10:30-4:30 (used).
OHV: 'Off Highway Vehicle use strictly prohibited.' - no OHV side.
